name: Boiler economizer (feedwater heat recovery)
description: Heat exchanger that raises feedwater temperature using flue gas leaving the boiler or superheater, cutting fuel use. Spirax Sarco gives about a 2% efficiency gain per 10 C rise in feedwater temperature; condensing economisers cool gas below the dew point and need corrosion-resistant surfaces. Primary source: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/miscellaneous-boiler-types-economisers-and-superheaters?sc_lang=en-GB

specifications.metric: efficiency improvement per feedwater temperature rise
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: in broad terms a 10 C increase in feedwater temperature gives about a 2% efficiency improvement
Spirax Sarco: about 1% less fuel required for every 6 C temperature rise in the feedtank
B&W: economiser metal temperature can increase at 30-50 F/h (17-28 C/h) during an offline/air-leakage period
ClearFire-CE AHRI thermal efficiency 96.0% with condensing heat exchanger
